paragraphs: HHAeXchange sells homecare software built as one platform connecting providers, payers, and caregivers. Homecare agencies rely on it to be more efficient in their day-to-day operations.

A flexible electronic visit verification system with a GPS mobile app handles caregiver clock-ins and clock-outs. On the revenue side, agencies validate patient pre-authorizations, monitor authorization usage, and stay on top of expirations. The CarePay payroll product runs on the same visit data, so shift differentials, wage parity, and blended overtime calculate automatically with tax filing on every paycheck. A separate offering for intellectual and developmental disability agencies covers documentation, billing, care coordination, and staff operations.

The company states it serves over 32,000 US providers, more than 180 managed care organizations, and 30 state Medicaid programs. Payroll and employee data is encrypted to bank-level standards that the company says meet or exceed HIPAA and SOC 2.
